integrity: Mathematical proof, exact stationary matrix formulas and executable numerical cross-check are included; no independent scientific audit or publication-priority certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No finite-m uniqueness assertion for the leaf-rooted optimum
Asymptotic behavior is in large star degree only
No result for hidden reset event labels, multiple reset sites, nonuniform hopping or arbitrary graphs
Potential implicit derivability from general network-entropy treatments remains a priority risk
scientific_scope: Discrete-time simple random walk on the loopless star with m>=2 leaves; independent per-step reset to a fixed hub or leaf; entropy of visited vertices. Exact finite-m formulas and asymptotic statements hold for all global leaf optimizers without assuming finite-m uniqueness.
title: Distinct optimal-reset exponents at the hub and leaves of a star
